outer_holdout: same deterministic target-level split as Experiments 011-012
strict_stacking: The statistical observer is never trained on the target group whose training example consumes its output. Five target-group folds are used inside the outer training partition. Validation/test observer outputs use a model trained on all outer-training targets.
local_statistics: Each biological channel also uses a cross-fitted cubic logistic calibration based on evidence presence and evidence-score powers.
global_statistical_observer: Masked polynomial logistic model over six scores, six evidence-presence flags, six pipeline-availability flags, pairwise score interactions, pairwise presence interactions, and evidence/availability counts.
ganglion: six biological encoders plus one statistical-observer encoder -> availability-normalized mean -> shared 16x16 tanh matrix -> Bernoulli terminal head
damage_tests: randomly mispair the statistical result with another evidence state
precision_test: validation-selected logit blend with the final masked-polynomial model; alpha in {0,.25,.5,.75,1}
